upsert_response: upsert a cached response entry into MongoDB with content, http status, and optional error code
get_response: get a cached response entry by kind, dataset, config, and split from MongoDB
delete_response: delete a cached response entry by kind, dataset, config, and split from MongoDB
get_cache_reports: get paginated cache reports for a given kind using cursor-based pagination
get_response_metadata: get metadata for a cached response including updated_at and failed_runs without content
